# msftncsi.com
> Microsoft NCSI endpoint domain used by Windows to verify internet connectivity and network status.

This domain is primarily used by the Windows Network Connectivity Status Indicator (NCSI) service for lightweight connectivity checks. It is not a product documentation site and exposes only a very small set of public endpoints; relevant Microsoft documentation about NCSI behavior lives on Microsoft Learn and related Microsoft support properties.

## Public Endpoints
- [NCSI active probe text](http://www.msftncsi.com/ncsi.txt): Plain-text endpoint used by Windows active probes to validate internet connectivity.
- [NCSI DNS probe host](http://dns.msftncsi.com/): Hostname used by Windows DNS-based connectivity checks.
- [Microsoft NCSI root](http://www.msftncsi.com/): Root domain associated with Windows network connectivity detection.

## Microsoft Learn Documentation
- [Network Connectivity Status Indicator and captive portal detection](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/networking/ncsi/ncsi-overview): Overview of how Windows determines internet access and captive portal state.
- [NCSI frequently asked questions](https://learn.microsoft.com/troubleshoot/windows-server/networking/troubleshoot-ncsi-guidance): Troubleshooting guidance for NCSI behavior, probes, and connectivity reporting.
- [Windows connection status indicator](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/nativewifi/about-the-network-list-manager-api): Related Windows networking APIs that expose connectivity state to applications.

## Windows Networking Reference
- [Network List Manager API](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/_nla/): Windows API reference for network awareness and connectivity status.
- [INetworkListManager interface](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/netlistmgr/nn-netlistmgr-inetworklistmanager): Interface for querying current network connectivity and internet access state.
- [NLM_CONNECTIVITY enumeration](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/netlistmgr/ne-netlistmgr-nlm_connectivity): Enumeration describing network and internet connectivity flags.
- [Network Awareness API portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/nativewifi/portal): Entry point for Windows native networking and awareness APIs.

## Troubleshooting and Operations
- [Troubleshoot NCSI and internet connectivity reporting](https://learn.microsoft.com/troubleshoot/windows-server/networking/troubleshoot-ncsi-guidance): Steps for diagnosing incorrect “No Internet” or captive portal indications.
- [Windows networking troubleshooting documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/networking/): Broader Windows Server networking documentation relevant to connectivity detection.
- [Microsoft support for Windows networking](https://support.microsoft.com/windows): General Windows support entry point for networking-related issues.

## Related Microsoft Properties
- [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/): Central documentation hub for Windows networking, APIs, and troubleshooting guidance.
- [Windows documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/): Top-level Windows documentation on Microsoft Learn.
- [Windows Server networking documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/networking/): Documentation for Windows Server networking features and operations.
